intent: Add revocable, scoped, rate-limited API keys across the users service, the gateway and the SDK, as specified in docs/API-KEYS.md
why: Integrators calling the gateway server-to-server only have short-lived bearer session tokens. They need long-lived, revocable, least-privilege credentials. The change adds API-key issuance and hashed storage in users, ApiKey authentication with scopes, per-key rate limit, key routes and log redaction in the gateway, and an apiKey credential and apiKeys resource in the SDK. Bearer sessions stay unchanged.
changes: users service gains apiKeys issue/list/revoke/rotate/verify with salted hashed storage
gateway accepts Authorization: ApiKey, enforces scopes and per-key rate limit, exposes key routes, redacts keys in logs and reads three new config variables
SDK gains apiKey credential, client.apiKeys and AuthError/ForbiddenError/RateLimitError
nonGoals: Changing bearer-session authentication or users CRUD behavior
Rate limiting session principals or public routes

userFlow.purpose: An integrator creates a key with a session, then calls with ApiKey; failures are 401/403/429.

Session or ApiKey with read, own user only
Session or ApiKey with write, own user only
Session or ApiKey with write, own user only

errors.when: invalid graceSeconds or key already revoked or expired

requirements.description: The users service SHALL issue, list, revoke, rotate and verify API keys in format ak_<prefix>_<secret>
requirements.outcome: service.apiKeys issue/list/revoke/rotate/verify behave per spec; parseApiKey and API_KEY_PATTERN are exported
details: Scopes are read/write, deduplicated, ordered, independent
Unknown or foreign prefix is NotFoundError

scenarios.name: Issue and verify
scenarios.when: a key is issued then verified
scenarios.then: verify returns ok with userId, prefix and scopes and lastUsedAt is set
and: issue returns the plaintext key only once

scenarios.name: Rotate with grace
scenarios.when: rotate is called with graceSeconds 30
scenarios.then: a new key with same label and scopes is returned and the old key is revoked at clock plus 30 seconds

scenarios.name: Verify rejections
scenarios.when: verify is given a malformed, unknown, revoked or expired key
scenarios.then: it returns ok false with reason malformed, unknown, revoked or expired
scenarios.recovery: Issue or rotate a new key

scenarios.name: Invalid issue input
scenarios.when: issue gets empty label, bad scopes or past expiresAt

scenarios.name: Foreign prefix
scenarios.when: revoke or rotate targets another user's prefix

scenarios.name: Rotate dead key
scenarios.when: rotate is called

scenarios.when: a key is issued
scenarios.then: the stored document contains a per-key salt and hash but not the key or secret

scenarios.name: Legacy document
scenarios.when: the service loads it and issues a key

scenarios.name: Delete user
scenarios.when: deleteUser runs

scenarios.name: List hides secrets
scenarios.when: list is called
scenarios.then: no key, secret, hash or salt field appears

requirements.description: The gateway SHALL authenticate ApiKey credentials and enforce scopes in the order authenticate, rate limit, scope, ownership
requirements.outcome: ApiKey requests produce an apiKey principal; failures give identical 401 and scope failures 403

scenarios.name: Valid ApiKey
scenarios.when: GET a protected route with Authorization: apikey <key>
scenarios.then: the request succeeds with principal type apiKey

scenarios.name: Bearer unchanged
scenarios.when: a session bearer token is used
scenarios.then: behavior is unchanged and the principal has every scope

scenarios.name: Indistinguishable 401
scenarios.when: credentials are missing, malformed, unknown, revoked or expired

scenarios.name: Missing scope
scenarios.when: POST is sent

scenarios.name: Ownership
scenarios.when: a key manages another user's resources

requirements.description: The gateway SHALL rate limit API-key requests per key prefix in fixed epoch-aligned windows
requirements.outcome: Over-limit requests get 429 rate_limited with Retry-After

scenarios.name: Within limit
scenarios.when: limit requests are made in one window

scenarios.name: Over limit
scenarios.when: limit plus one requests are made in one window
scenarios.then: 429 rate_limited with Retry-After seconds to window end rounded up, minimum 1

scenarios.name: New window
scenarios.when: the clock crosses a multiple of windowMs

scenarios.name: Sessions exempt
scenarios.when: session bearer requests exceed the limit

scenarios.name: Revoke and rotate

requirements.description: The gateway SHALL never log a full API key or secret
requirements.outcome: Logs carry only prefix-level information for ApiKey requests

scenarios.then: authorization logs as ApiKey ak_<prefix>_[redacted] and auth is {type, userId, keyPrefix}

scenarios.name: Malformed header
scenarios.when: a malformed key is sent

scenarios.name: Rejected requests
scenarios.when: revoked or rate-limited keys are used
scenarios.then: no log line contains the full key or secret

requirements.description: The SDK SHALL support apiKey credentials, an apiKeys resource and typed errors
requirements.outcome: createClient accepts apiKey and exposes apiKeys create/list/rotate/revoke; 401/403/429 raise typed errors

scenarios.name: ApiKey header
scenarios.when: client is created with apiKey

scenarios.name: Resource calls
scenarios.when: create, list, rotate, revoke are called
scenarios.then: correct URL-encoded paths are used and results are object, array, object, undefined

coverage.rationale: Additive feature; new config variables have backward-compatible defaults and bearer auth is untouched.

currentState: The gateway authenticates only Bearer session tokens via src/auth.js; users has no API-key support; the SDK sends only a bearer token.
compatibility: All existing exports, bearer-session authentication and users CRUD stay unchanged; old store documents without apiKeys still load.
